content: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
sourceWork: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's Essays & Philosophical Writings
story:
Preserved as part of Antoine de Saint-Exupéry's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of heart and love. Across his life and work, Antoine de Saint-Exupéry returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
